components.name: method
values: anti-cd3/cd28 stimulation | jurkat cells serum-starved for 3 h then stimulated with 1 ug/ml anti-cd3 and 1 ug/ml anti-cd28 antibodies for 4 h naive controls subjected to continued starvation

crop-seq data preprocessing | drop-seq tools v1.12 used cell barcode bases 1-12 and umi bases 13-20 from read1 tagged to transcriptome read2 trimmed reads aligned with star v2.4.0 to human reference grch38 plus artificial chromosomes representing cropseq-guide-puro construct cell barcode correction allowing up to 4 base mismatches umi deduplication digital gene expression matrix built for cells with 500 genes grna assignment most abundant grna per cell dominant grna must be >3 sum of others for unique assignment

crop-seq lentiviral construct assembly | cropseq-guide-puro plasmid assembled from four pcr products using ligase cycling reaction contains hu6-grna cassette inserted into the 3 ltr of lentiguide-puro

drop-seq single-cell rna-seq | cells and barcoded beads coencapsulated in microfluidic droplets droplets broken with perfluoroctanol beads collected by syringe filtration reverse transcription and exonuclease i treatment pcr for 4 + 10 cycles nextera xt library preparation sequenced on illumina hiseq 3000/4000 or nextseq 500

indel analysis by next-generation sequencing | amplicons <500 bp with grna target at center pcr purified nextera xt library preparation sequenced on illumina miseq 150-cycle v3 flow cell reads extracted using anchor sequences indel size calculated as deviation from expected 100 bp fragment

lentiviral transduction for suspension cells | jurkat cells at 5 million cells/well in six-well plates with 8 ug/ml polybrene virus added plate centrifuged at 37 c and 1 200 rcf for 45 min selection with puromycin started at 48 h cells grown for 10 days under selection

lentivirus production and titration | hek293t cells seeded at 50 000 cells/well in 24-well plates transduced with lentivirus in 1 5 dilution series selection with puromycin or blasticidin resistant colonies stained with crystal violet after 10-14 days titer calculated as colonies dilution factor 20

t7 endonuclease assay | pcr primers designed so grna target is off-center 200 ng purified pcr product denatured and reannealed digested with 1 ul t7 endonuclease i at 37 c for 15 min analyzed on agilent high sensitivity dna chip editing efficiency = average digested1 digested2 / sum average digested1 digested2 undigested

genome editing efficiency assessment t7 endonuclease assay and next-generation sequencing of pcr amplicons in k562 jurkat and hek293t cells
proof-of-concept screen crop-seq analysis of tcr signaling in jurkat cells using a library of 87 grnas targeting tcr-related genes 20 nontargeting controls and 9 essential gene controls
validation of lentiviral function comparison of viral titers between lentiguide-puro and cropseq-guide-puro for three grnas and a filler construct
